items.title: What Alphabet (GOOGL)'s Gemini Enterprise Push Into Regulated Industries Means For Shareholders
items.summary: In recent days, Alphabet’s Google Cloud unit has broadened its Gemini Enterprise AI platform across financial services and legal sectors, integrating partners such as Deutsche Bank, CME Group, Moody’s, Dun & Bradstreet and FlowX.AI, while also rolling out new cost-control tools and flexible pricing to make enterprise AI adoption more manageable. These moves deepen Gemini’s role inside heavily regulated, data-intensive workflows and suggest Google Cloud is becoming an embedded operating layer...

items.title: PCE Inflation Data Sets High Bar For Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's primary inflation gauge, the core PCE price index, showed no relief from price pressures ahead of Chairman Kevin Warsh's Friday speech at the annual Jackson Hole monetary policy symposium.  Given that three Fed voters dissented from last month's decision to hold the benchmark interest rate steady, Warsh's ability to influence hawkish-leaning colleagues is in question.  Markets are now pricing in 40% odds of a rate hike on Sept. 16, up from 36% ahead of this morning's data, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool.
